title: Composing Quantum Instruments
summary: We study the composition of classically-controlled quantum instruments--the natural quantum analogue of Markov kernels. Classically, Markov kernels compose by integrating one kernel against another. Defining this composition for quantum instruments with continuous outcomes requires an integral of quantum channel-valued functions with respect to a quantum instrument. We construct this integral in the Heisenberg picture using the Okamura-Ozawa normal extension to a von Neumann tensor product.
